Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.shape

Class SoftShadow

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.SceneGraphObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Node
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Leaf
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Shape3D
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.shape.SoftShadow
public class SoftShadow extends Shape3D
A GPU soft rectangular drop shadow: a single quad drawn behind a window (or HUD card) whose per-fragment alpha is evaluated from the exact signed distance to the window rect, ramping from alpha at the rect edge down to fully transparent across a per-side penumbra. It supersedes the 2006 baked RectShadow, which faked the falloff with a 28-vertex ring of Gouraud-interpolated per-vertex alpha; here the falloff is smooth, resolution-independent and a constant world width at any window size.

Like RectShadow this is a non-pickable Shape3D sized in place via setSize(float, float) (the vertex buffer and the uHalfWin uniform both carry write capability, so a live window can be resized without rebuilding the graph). Unlike RectShadow it needs the GLSL program from ShaderEffects.softShadowProgram(); because that can return null when the shader resources are unavailable, construct instances through create(float, float, float, float, float, float, float, float) and fall back to RectShadow when it returns null.

The SDF shader clamps the falloff inside the window rect to a flat alpha, so RectShadow's inner overlap margin (used only to hide the seam where its ring met the opaque centre) has no meaning here and is not part of this signature; the shadow quad simply spans the window rect plus the outer penumbra on each side.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public static SoftShadow create(float width, float height, float north, float east, float south, float west, float zShift, float alpha)
      Builds a soft drop shadow, or returns null when the GPU shader program cannot be assembled (missing/unreadable GLSL resources) so the caller can fall back to the fixed-function RectShadow.
      Parameters:
      width - window width the shadow is cast by (world units)
      height - window height the shadow is cast by (world units)
      north - penumbra width extending beyond the window's +y edge
      east - penumbra width extending beyond the window's +x edge
      south - penumbra width extending beyond the window's -y edge
      west - penumbra width extending beyond the window's -x edge
      zShift - z the quad is parked at (behind the window body)
      alpha - peak shadow opacity at the window edge

    • setSize

      public void setSize(float width, float height)
      Resizes the shadow to a new window size in place: rewrites the quad's vertex buffer and the uHalfWin uniform. Legal on a live graph because both were built with write capability.
